name: Windows SEHOP Enabled
description:
Ensures Structured Exception Handler Overwrite Protection is enabled (DisableExceptionChainValidation = 0), blocking a common exploitation technique.
Required Windows permission (remedy only): the LEA agent account must be allowed to run reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\kernel" /v DisableExceptionChainValidation (administrator rights) via a delegated run-as permission, Scheduled Task, or service configuration.

remedy.command: reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\kernel" /v DisableExceptionChainValidation /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f | Out-Null; reg query "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\kernel" /v DisableExceptionChainValidation
